sampling: Exploratory screening, one or two alternating rounds; distinct from final three-round cohort. Every raw process row retained.

notes.unicode: Redundant initial whitespace scan; slower Unicode case.
notes.unicode-ascii: Built but not timed separately; added ASCII shortcut before next experiment.
notes.unicode-once: Candidate at c984e3b, Unicode scan once, final build also 1d9699a (test-only change). Dense controls later exposed regression.
notes.fused: Resumed normalization after canonical prefix; no useful gain. Test-only assertion corrected after build; the archive patch contains that assertion correction.
notes.shared: Shared scalar whitespace scanner; nearly doubles long ASCII fallback controls.
notes.push: Explicit nested pushes for all Unicode folding; rejected.
notes.upper-property: Skip lowercasing non-uppercase scalars, still extends uppercase iterator.
notes.direct-push: Rejected: long all-uppercase Unicode control exposed ~36% regression. Mixed-case and lowercase controls alone had hidden this.
notes.word-iterator: Rejected: word-sized iterator folding also regressed dense/long uppercase Unicode.
notes.string-fold: Skip lowercase string conversion when no uppercase scalar exists. This screening did not yet exempt ASCII uppercase. Shared host activity caused substantial spread; all records retained. Final algorithm at 7663402 exempts ASCII uppercase too.
notes.outline-fold: Rejected: inline(never) generated identical __text bytes and identical disassembly (excluding path header). Shared helper was already called out of line. Screening retained as code-equivalent variability control.

host_observation: During string-fold screening an unrelated process used roughly one CPU core; no thermal/power warning was reported. Shared-host variability affects timings; final cohort is separate.
